description: This file defines a mock class 'CurlWrapsImplMock' for testing, which inherits from 'CurlWrapsImpl' and mocks several cURL multi interface functions using Google Mock.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for CurlWrapsImpl, providing mock implementations for cURL multi handle functions.

methods.name: curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Mock method for curl_multi_perform, performs perform operation on the cURL multi handle.

methods.name: curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Mock method for curl_multi_info_read, reads information from the multi handle queue.

methods.name: curl_multi_poll
methods.description: Mock method for curl_multi_poll, waits for action on the multi handle with a timeout.
